summary: Mineral County authorities searched near West Fork Road after Gabriel Max Baldonado’s vehicle was discovered under a pile of logs on August 13, 2020. A search with human-remains detection dogs did not locate him. He remained missing as of the October 21 report; possible later sightings were unconfirmed.
location: West Fork Road (FSR 648), below Wolf Creek Pass overlook
notes: DGO report published October 21, 2020, including an interview with the Mineral County sheriff. Date is vehicle discovery, not a confirmed disappearance or search date. The report does not establish a connection between this case and other disappearances nearby. Outcome is historical, not a current case status.
